        pass
# just find lines with zone label
for kw in ['"DataCenter_bot_ZN_6"','"Perimeter_top_ZN_3"']:
    for m in re.finditer(re.escape(kw), data):
        start = data.rfind('\n', 0, m.start())
        # find subject line just before
        chunk = data[max(0,m.start()-300):m.start()]
        subj = re.findall(r'\n([A-Za-z0-9_:#]+) a (brick:[A-Za-z_]+)', chunk)
